decision.explanation: Both '28 March 1613' and '31 May 1599' are valid birth dates for distinct individuals from the Borjigit clan. '28 March 1613' refers to Empress Xiaozhuangwen (also known as Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang) in D1S1, while '31 May 1599' refers to Empress Xiaoduanwen in D2S3. These are two different historical figures sharing the same clan name and thus represent distinct valid answers.
